selection.eligible_universe: all Mondays from 2024-01-01 through 2025-11-24 excluding previously used candidate-02 weeks
selection.selection_method: Python random.Random(seed).choice over chronologically sorted eligible Mondays

locked_hypothesis.market_logic: A frozen dealing-range extreme is an external liquidity pool. A directional aggressive-flow sweep that promptly closes back inside is a failed auction. Opposite displacement through pre-sweep internal structure plus a fair-value gap proves a change in delivery. The first later retrace into the imbalance offers entry toward the opposing external pool.
no_trade_states: both range boundaries swept in the same minute
break remains accepted outside the range
sweep extension exceeds the locked structural ceiling
cost-after reward/risk below the locked floor

promotion_rule: The 20-minute portfolio and at least one adjacent retrace horizon must pass every original weekly gate, and scheduled signals must span at least two cycle anchors. Otherwise perform one core-variable ablation on the revealed week before discarding.
